ORAL ORDER 2 14-03-2024 Heard learned Senior counsel for the petitioner, State and the informant.
2. The petitioner is an accused in connection with Complaint Case No. 539 of 2023 for the offence under sections 498A, 420/34 of the IPC and sections 3,4 of D.P. Act lodged on 13.03.2023 by the complainant, Rashmi Kumari.

3. Since the complainant has already appeared, with the consent of the parties, let the matter go before the Mediation Center where the couple will appear on 21.03.2024 and a report be submitted on 02.04.2024.

4. In the meantime, no coercive steps shall be taken Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.16136 of 2024(2) dt.14-03-2024 against the petitioner in connection with Complaint Case No. 539 of 2023 pending in the Court of learned Sub Divisional Judicial Magistrate, Purnea.
